en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning in force as cold front arrives
en.dek: The Observatory raised both signals at 06:10 HKT; northerly winds exceed 40 km/h with gusts to gale force, and temperatures will fall to about 16C by Tuesday morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal is now in force, with strong northerly winds of mean speed exceeding 40 kilometres per hour expected and gusts occasionally reaching gale force. The Red Fire Danger Warning is also in effect, indicating extreme fire risk.

In the past hour ending around 07:30, Waglan Island recorded a maximum sustained wind of 63 kilometres per hour and a gust of 72 kilometres per hour, while Sai Kung saw 41 kilometres per hour sustained and 69 kilometres per hour gusts. The Observatory advised people in exposed areas to secure flower pots and loose objects, small-craft owners to ensure boats are safe, and the public to stay away from the shoreline and avoid water sports due to rough seas.

A cold front is crossing the Guangdong coast, bringing the intense northeast monsoon. Today will be cooler in the morning with a few light rain patches, becoming fine and dry later, with temperatures from 19 to 26 degrees Celsius and relative humidity 45 to 85 per cent. North winds of force 5, force 6 offshore and up to force 8 on high ground are expected, with temperatures falling further at night.

On Tuesday the urban area is forecast to see 16 to 23 degrees Celsius, fine and very dry during the day with relative humidity down to 35 per cent. New Territories readings will be a couple of degrees lower. The public should take note of the temperature drop and look after the elderly and those with chronic illnesses, the Observatory said.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告生效 冷鋒抵港
zh.dek: 天文台於清晨6時10分發出兩項警告；偏北強風平均超過每小時40公里，陣風達烈風，周二早上市區最低約16度。
body: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號現正生效，預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。紅色火災危險警告同時生效，火災危險性極高。
截至約上午7時30分的過去一小時，橫瀾島錄得最高持續風速每小時63公里、最高陣風72公里；西貢則為持續41公里、陣風69公里。天文台提醒身處當風地方的市民採取預防措施，將花盆及易被吹倒物件搬入室內；小艇艇戶確保船隻安全；因海面可能大浪，應遠離岸邊並停止水上活動。
一道冷鋒正橫過廣東沿岸，隨後強烈東北季候風影響該區。今日早上較涼並有一兩陣雨，日間漸轉天晴乾燥，氣溫介乎19至26度，相對濕度45至85%。吹北風5級，離岸6級，高地達8級，晚間氣溫進一步下降。
星期二早上市區最低約16度，日間天晴非常乾燥，相對濕度可低至35%，新界再低一兩度。天文台呼籲市民留意氣溫變化，注意保暖，並關顧長者及慢性病患者。
